examples.title: Load an EXR image sequence
examples.code:
# Create a Read for a frame-numbered EXR sequence.
read = nuke.createNode("Read")
read["file"].setValue("D:/renders/shot/beauty.####.exr")
read["first"].setValue(1001)
read["last"].setValue(1100)

examples.title: Find every Read node using EXR files
Move selected Reads to a new render directory
examples.code:
# Replace part of the file path on selected Read nodes.
for read in nuke.selectedNodes("Read"):
    old_path = read["file"].value()
    new_path = old_path.replace("D:/renders/old/", "D:/renders/new/")
    read["file"].setValue(new_path)
